A rare lakefront retreat, fully turn-key.

Nestled on the shores of Fairbank Lake, this beautifully maintained 1,230 sq. ft. bungalow offers the kind of waterfront lifestyle most people only dream about. A 135-foot shoreline, a finished walkout basement, and an attached garage combine genuine four-season livability with effortless cottage charm.

The property has been thoughtfully upgraded throughout — from a high-efficiency propane furnace and in-floor bathroom heating to Starlink connectivity and a whole-home backup generator. Everything you need is already here.
